items.title: In one of the largest deals in tech history, Marvell buys Lumentum for $115B
items.summary: Marvell's planned purchase of Lumentum is one of the biggest acquisitions in tech history. And they both have the same strategic investor: Nvidia.
items.creator: Julie Bort

items.title: Readwise takes on Amazon’s Kindle and Goodreads with its new app for book lovers
items.summary: Readwise Books combines an ebook store, reading tracker, detailed reading stats, and AI features in a bid to challenge Amazon's ecosystem.
items.creator: Sarah Perez
